parsed.name: MGT508高速瞬态数据采集器
parsed.name_en: MGT508 High-Speed Transient Data Acquisition Unit
parsed.description: MGT508是一种高速瞬态数据采集设备，可将实验中的快速电信号捕获到板载存储中，并在采集后将数据回传到主机。它适用于脉冲过程、瞬态波形和其他需要短时高速记录的测量场景。
parsed.description_en: The MGT508 is a high-speed transient data acquisition instrument that captures fast electrical signals into onboard memory and returns the recorded data to a host after acquisition. It is suited to pulsed processes, transient waveform recording, and other experiments requiring short-duration high-speed capture.

actions.description: 拉取设备已采集的数据。
actions.description_en: Pull the data captured by the device.
